newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.584 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.584 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate rose to 2.584 percent a month, from 2.561 percent last week, at today's 6.291 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on November 27. Today's auction is expected to drain 291 million reais from the banking system, with 6.0 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
